description.value: An independently owned neighborhood pub on South Fraser Way in Abbotsford, The Tipsy Barrel offers pub classics, regional seafood specials, and handcrafted cocktails in a three-story commercial building with outdoor seating. It runs a packed weekly events calendar including Wednesday Crab Night with live music, Thursday Trivia, and DJ nights every Friday and Saturday. A touring cyclist looking for a hearty sit-down meal, cold drinks, and a lively local atmosphere in central Abbotsford will find it here.
